title: 先思考再安慰：面向协议化老年认知刺激智能体的反思性认知对齐
summary: 针对认知刺激疗法（CST）缺乏专业引导者及粤语等低资源语言数据稀缺问题，提出STaR-CS合成多方对话数据，并构建反思性认知对齐（RCA）框架，通过协议约束认知链（PC-CoC）与推理时价值对齐（IVA）提升LLM的协议遵循、安全性与共情能力。
summary_en: To address the lack of trained facilitators and data scarcity in Cantonese for Cognitive Stimulation Therapy, this work proposes STaR-CS to synthesize multi-party dialogues and a Reflective Cognitive Alignment (RCA) framework combining Protocol-Constrained Chain-of-Cognition (PC-CoC) and Inference-Time Value Alignment (IVA), improving protocol adherence, safety, and empathy in LLMs.
